mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM reminder_record
AND relationship_id = #{relationshipId}
ORDER BY reminder_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder_record (relationship_id, reminder_time, receiver, reminder_type) VALUES (#{relationshipId}, #{reminderTime}, #{receiver}, #{reminderType})
mapper.select: SELECT rr.id, rr.relationship_id, rr.reminder_time, rr.receiver, rr.reminder_type, r.name as relationship_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.birthday, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthday_date, rp.days_before as days_before_reminder, r.greeting as greeting, r.self_call as self_call FROM reminder_record rr INNER JOIN relationship r ON rr.relationship_id = r.id LEFT JOIN reminder_plan rp ON rr.relationship_id = rp.relationship_id AND rp.execution_status = 0 WHERE rr.reminder_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AND rr.reminder_time <= NOW() ORDER BY rr.reminder_time ASC LIMIT 50
